info.title: Immigration court backlog, representation and asylum outcomes (EOIR workload statistics and case data): data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
Immigration court backlog, representation and asylum outcomes (EOIR workload statistics and case data): The size and movement of the U.S. immigration court backlog, from the Executive Office for Immigration Review (EOIR). National series from EOIR's workload and adjudication statistics: pending cases, new cases, completions, the share of completed cases with a representative on record, asylum decisions and the share of grants among grants and denials, asylum applications pending and pending cases of unaccompanied children, by fiscal year. Pending proceedings by immigration court, by the respondent's state of address and by nationality, counted from EOIR's monthly FOIA case-data file, with the share that has a representative of record. Counts only: no case row, name or address is published, and every cell under 11 is suppressed. Every national table is re-added against its own totals row; the case-data counts are shown beside the published totals and never spliced into them.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
